# Upstream experiment provenance

The original experiment collection was based on Nicholas Krämer's MIT-licensed
`experiments-lanczos-adjoints` repository for *Gradients of functions of large
matrices* (2024). Its MIT notice is retained here. The release drivers use the
published `matfree` dependency for the adjoint baseline. No `matfree_extensions`
modules are needed by the paper-only drivers, so none are bundled. This directory
records attribution and is not an importable Python package.
